lines.zh: 我一步步踩过沼泽的泥。
lines.en: I step through the swamp mud.
My legs are long and my walk is steady.

lines.zh: 我抬脚时泥水被带起来。
lines.en: Mud lifts when I raise a foot.
I walk slowly along the forest edge.
My feathers are always damp.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的树影里走出去。
lines.en: I walk out of the dark forest's shadow.
I turn my head to look around.
I halt in the shallows.
My claws grip the soft mud.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边动着冠羽。
lines.en: I work my crest feathers as I walk.
Around a fallen tree.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向干燥的地方。
lines.en: I head slowly for drier ground.
I stand, my crest half open.
I am scanning my surroundings.
My eyes never rest.
The swamp's smell is strong.
I stand with the sun at my back.
My tail feathers sweep the mud.
Swamp mud grips my claws.
The dark forest is very dim.

lines.zh: 我的喙在泥面上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I rub my beak against the mud.
I scratch in the mud with a claw.

lines.zh: 数据在我身上静静地流。
lines.en: Data flows quietly through me.
I stand near my anchor.
My crest draws in a little.
I hear something moving in the water.

lines.zh: 这里是沼泽，你不该穿这鞋。
lines.en: This is a swamp. Those boots are a poor choice.
I am an Adult-level Digimon.
Take off that straw hat.
I will use Petit Twister.
You can assign me to farming.
My stats can still grow.

lines.zh: 你要我打近的还是远的？
lines.en: Would you have me fight close or far?
I see further than you do.
A marsh cockatrice, standing in mud.
My beak points your way.
I dislike clutter on the ground.
If you have an order, say it plainly.
I see very clearly from here.
Our link is open.
I await training.
There is mud on you.
A chunk of my stats is gone.
My crest is askew; I set it straight.
A few feathers were knocked out of place.
My data flow jolted.
I readjusted my angle.
I raise a leg to guard my body.
That blow has been logged.
My crest droops.
I retreat to drier ground.
Mud clings to my tail feathers.
You hold it up over the mud.

lines.zh: 我先扫了一下它的数据。
lines.en: I scan its data first.
I tilt my head and do not reach for it.
Lower it; I can reach.

lines.zh: 我的爪子不好抓小东西。
lines.en: My claws are poor at small things.
That is too little energy.
I lower my head to look.
You may keep it yourself.
Later, after training.

lines.zh: 数据记下了，只是一点点。
lines.en: Logged. Only a little.
I slowly furl my crest.
The mud will ruin this.

lines.zh: 我的爪在泥里抓出一道沟。
lines.en: My claws carve a groove in the mud.
My long legs stand like two posts.

lines.zh: 泥水溅到我们两个身上。
lines.en: Mud splashes on both of us.
My feathers got knocked askew.
I lift a leg to balance.
That made the ground sink.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，绕了过去。
lines.en: I lift one foot and step around.

lines.zh: 你退开两步，我才能转身。
lines.en: Two steps back and I can turn.
This mud is too soft.
We pass each other slowly.

lines.zh: 你在前面走，我后面压着。
lines.en: You walk ahead; I cover the rear.
Our speeds can match.
I use the twister; you use something else.
Leave the farming to me.
By my leg is the safest place for you.
We patrol this wood together.
After the fight we return to the anchor.
I will not leave you behind.
The data will remember you.
We train until dark, then stop.
I lower my head and pick it up.
My claws do not grip it well.
I carry it in my beak.
Its data is unremarkable.
I set it on dry ground.

lines.zh: 我伸喙把它从泥里夹出。
lines.en: I reach my beak down and pluck it from the mud.
I flick it with a claw tip.

lines.zh: 这东西湿了就不能用了。
lines.en: Once wet, this is useless.
I hand this to you.
I have noted its position.
Target in range.
Head up, crest feathers bristling.
My crest has opened.
I choose a ranged attack.
It is a head shorter than I am.
I cut in from the flank.
You block its retreat.
I have its breathing counted.
The mud will slow its steps.
I have logged its movements.
This angle is very good.
Begin combat now.

lines.zh: 我在算它踩进泥坑的时机。
lines.en: I time the moment it steps into the mud pit.
Each step it retreats, I advance.
Cockatrimon's talons spread wide.
I wait for it to step into soft mud.
It does not see the hollow under the mud.
My crest is raised toward it.
It has begun glancing back.
I have enough data now.
One step more and I strike.
Its movements are disordered.

lines.zh: 我抬起爪，对准它的侧面。
lines.en: I raise a claw toward its flank.
Engaging now.
I open my beak and the air whirls.
Petit Twister strikes it.
My claws sweep and leave three lines.
It blocked that blow.
I step back to charge again.
The wind pushes it back half a step.
I raise a long leg and kick.
Mud is thrown everywhere.
Hit. The numbers have updated.
The ground gave when I landed.
Its attack has weakened.
I prepare another whirl.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林的边缘走出来。
lines.en: I walk out from the edge of the dark forest.

lines.zh: 沼泽上多了一个高瘦的影子。
lines.en: There is one more tall shape on the swamp.
My crest rises first.
I settle beside my anchor.
My stats were set at generation.
Mud drips from my feet.
I sweep the area with my gaze.
This swamp suits my legs.
I keep watch over this stretch.
My beak is long and hard.
The smell of swamp gas drifts in first.

lines.zh: 数据流在我身上稳定下来。
lines.en: The data flow stabilizes over me.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛被烤得卷起来。
lines.en: The heat has curled my feathers.
I fall into the mud, sunk to the knee.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的腿，我走不动。
lines.en: Water rises past my legs and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的姿态打散了。
lines.en: The blast breaks my stance.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的翅侧。
lines.en: Something stuck in my flank.

lines.zh: 我的程序一时读不出数据。
lines.en: My program briefly fails to read the data.
Low energy; my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 电击让我的数据跳了一下。
lines.en: The shock makes my data skip.

lines.zh: 这里没有锚点可以定位。
lines.en: There is no anchor here to fix on.
